This plot is small but it is my main food for the family, so I must do my best with maize. I will try to use the FISP coupons if I get them this year — one bag of NPK and one of urea is what I usually aim for. I have no money to spare for pesticide, and I cannot pay people to work when my own plot is so small; I will work it with my family. We always plant on ridges by hand-hoe, and I will mix in some pigeon pea like usual.
